conviction_note: H1 will clear the company's very low H1 plan by roughly 20% (Q1 alone was 64% of it and the Q2 monthly sales were about flat), but the street (IFIS FY OP 51.2bn against the company's 47.0bn) already models that beat. So the print turns on whether the FY plan is raised to meet the street. The company did not pre-release a revision as it did in 2024, and this name sold a decent Q1 beat by 7.6%. Small offsetting findings, sum +0.2, p_up 52 on an abs move of 3.5.
bar: Company H1 plan, business profit / OP 22.0bn and net 14.0bn (Q1 短信 2026-06-30, https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/30860/140120260630584490.pdf). Market bar for FY: IFIS consensus OP 51,175m, pretax 46,675m, NP 31,500m against company 47,000 / 42,000 / 29,000, five analysts, avg TP 2,558 (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=3086, data 2026-10-09). print_vs_bar is my estimate of H1 business profit (~26.5bn) against the 22.0bn company H1 plan. There is no sourced H1 consensus.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 1.38% as of 2026-09-29 (prev 1.44%, -0.06pt, one seller, covering slightly), from the baseline (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 1.4, balanced. No option skew exists. Activist 3D Investment Partners is at 11.63% (obligation date 2026-09-03), the No.2 holder and still adding through early September. Nomura group at 8.73%. Stock ~2,752 at 10:03 JST against ~3,617 before the Q1 print (-24%). 20d run-up +6.1% and 5d +5.7% are a rebound off ~2,610. priced_lean +0.57.

findings.finding: H1 business profit will come in about 20% above the company's own H1 plan of 22.0bn, at roughly 25-27bn. Q1 was already 14.1bn (64% of the H1 plan, +1.7% YoY). Q2 needs only 7.9bn against 14.3bn last year, and the Q2 monthly reports show department-store gross sales about -0.3% (Jun -0.6, Jul +0.6, Aug -0.8), PARCO tenant sales +3.7/+13.8/+9.2, and developer revenue about flat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 (2026-06-30, 15:30): business profit 14.1bn, +1.7%, 64% of the H1 plan, read by Fisco as 'ahead of plan'. Stock -7.6% next day (3,617 -> 3,342) on 出尽くし after a run-up (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3086&b=n202607010983). Yahoo EPS surprises were positive on all of the last four quarters, and the reactions were mostly negative.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: anyone can compute the 64% progress rate from the Q1 短信, and IFIS FY consensus already sits 9% above the company OP plan. What is left is the size of the Q2 margin. Q2 IFRS revenue was about -1.7% YoY and there is no Q2 profit consensus on file, so a Q2 business profit near or above last year's 14.3bn would be a surprise and ~11bn would not.
findings.independence: Monthly 連結売上収益報告 for Jun/Jul/Aug: https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/30860/140120260715594445.pdf, https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/30860/140120260817521753.pdf, https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120260915536666.pdf (H1 consolidated IFRS revenue -2.8%, gross +2.5%). These are a different document from the 短信 and show the same picture.

findings.finding: The FY plan is heavily H2-weighted (H2 business profit 30.0bn, +33.8% YoY, including developer H2 7.9bn, +169%, from property sales), and the street is already above it (IFIS OP 51.2bn vs 47.0bn). No 業績予想の修正 was filed before this print, unlike 2024 (2024-06-28 and 2024-09-24). That points to the H1 beat staying inside the 30% profit threshold and gives some risk that the FY plan is held rather than raised to the street.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 FY26 (2025-10-14): FY cut (business profit -5.5bn vs the April plan), estimated reaction -3.29% in the baseline. H1 FY24 (2023-10-10): FY raised the same evening. FY25: raised in a pre-release on 2024-09-24.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at 51.2bn already assumes a raise. If the market assumed a hold, consensus would sit near 47bn and the target price would be lower. A hold that cites H2 developer and Umeda risk is the release adding something. The absence of a pre-release is visible on TDnet and has not been called out in any coverage I found.
findings.independence: IFIS consensus page https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=3086 (consensus pretax drifted from 47,367 four weeks ago to 46,675) and the TDnet disclosure list via https://webapi.yanoshin.jp/webapi/tdnet/list/3086.json (no revision since 2025-10-14). September department-store sales -0.8% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3086&b=n202610020441) but tax-free +36.9% month to date on 9/14 (Aug report). These cut both ways for H2.

findings.finding: Activist 3D Investment Partners raised its stake from 7.55% (late June) to 11.63% (obligation date 2026-09-03) and is now the No.2 holder, with a stated purpose that includes proposals to the board. That makes a capital-return or capital-policy response at the H1 print a live option, although the FY26 100bn buyback is complete and Q1 cash was only 25.6bn with debt up 16.8bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Stock rose on the 3D stake filings (2026-07-09 '続伸…思惑'). At the last two H1 prints (Oct 2024, Oct 2025) no buyback came with the results; buybacks were announced at FY prints (Apr 2024, Apr 2025, Apr 2026).
findings.why_not_priced: The stake is public and was bid up in July, but the stock has since fallen ~24%, so the activist premium has evidently not held. An H1 buyback has no precedent at this company, so a priced probability would be low. Small expected value with a fat right tail.
findings.independence: Company's own 主要株主の異動 notice https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120260907532655.pdf (11.18% of votes, No.2 holder). FY presentation says total payout ~77% over the MTP and a new MTP aimed at ROE 10%+ is being drafted (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/30860/140120260414503510.pdf).

outside_window.finding: Next mid-term plan (ROE 10%+ target) is due with the FY results around April 2027, which is the more likely venue for an activist-driven capital policy.
Takashimaya (8233) reports H1 on 2026-10-15, after this window, so there is no peer read-through.

searched_and_found_nothing: TDnet list for 3086 (yanoshin API): no 業績予想の修正 or 配当予想の修正 since 2025-10-14, and no buyback since the one that ended 2026-06-05
Nikkei-style 観測記事 on J.Front H1 / FY revision before this print: none found by WebSearch
H1-specific sell-side consensus: not available; only FY IFIS consensus
Peer prints inside the window: Takashimaya reports 10/15 and Mitsukoshi Isetan in November, so none before the exit
Company IR site not tried, since the JPX archive (www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/30860/) carried every document needed

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: plausible, FY consensus OP 51.2bn vs plan 47.0bn and H1 tracking ~+20% vs plan, but no pre-release was filed and H2 is back-loaded, so a hold is a real possibility. Returns: interim dividend 28 yen planned; no H1 buyback precedent; activist at 11.6% is optionality. New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter vs own progress rate: H1 OP/FY plan would be ~56% against 61% last year (H1 29,975 / FY 49,015), with H1 last year flattered by asset sales.

rejected_candidates.detail: Folded into the guidance finding as H2 evidence. It cuts both ways because tax-free was +36.9% month to date.

rejected_candidates.detail: Part of the IFIS consensus target and rating already used as the bar.

baseline_tension: The findings net to a small positive, in line with priced_lean +0.57 and the short covering. Against them stand this name's habit of selling beats (Q1 -7.6%) and a 5-day run-in of +5.7%. The strongest positive the release could carry is an FY raise to the street plus a buyback answering the 3D stake, and I looked for both: neither is pre-signalled.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (a negative resting on public series pushes p_up toward 50) was already met at p_up 52, and the one negative rests on the FY decision the release adds rather than on 月次. Rule 2: I looked for positives (H1 beat, buyback, activist) and filed two. Open question 4 (run-in as a short signal): the run-in was not sized as a finding.
